skill_name: Explain how AI can help improve healthcare.
workflow: AI can help improve healthcare by streamlining processes such as medical diagnosis, treatment and imaging. AI algorithms can be trained to analyse medical records, and detect signs of abnormalities or diseases based on objective criteria, thus reducing the need for manual inspections. AI can also be used in the areas of medical imaging, drug development and precision medicine.
